questions.help: 7 Headlights – main beam / high beam / long range        7.2 Use of main beam / high beam / long range headlights  It is permissible to use the main beam headlights, including inside a built-uparea, for the same purposes as the audible warning instrument – horn (See article 21). When used in this manner, they are used as quick intermittent, ‘flashes’, so as not to cause glare or dazzle to other road users.(Página 100 del manual 'Learning to drive')8 Headlights - Low beam / dipped beam / short range               8.2 Use of the low beam headlights Remember: Low beam headlights should be used during daylight hours when lighting is reduced due to adverse meteorological conditions or environmental conditions.Headlights can be used in substitution of the audible warning device (horn).(Página 102 del manual 'Learning to drive')21 Audible warning instrument - horn The horn can only be used in certain circumstances, as a warning to:Avoid a possible accident; such as in narrow roads, hump back bridges or roads with bends with little or no visibility.To warn, on roads outside of a built-up-area, that the vehicle behind is overtaking or planning to do so.To warn other road users, that the vehicle is being used as a highpriority vehicle –normally reserved for emergency service vehicles.(Página 106 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
Circulando por vía urbana, para evitar un posible accidente, ¿cómo indicará su presencia a otro vehículo que pretende incorporarse a la circulación?
When travelling along an urban road, to avoid a potential accident, how should you indicate your presence to another vehicle which wants to join traffic?

answers.text:
No, en ningún caso.
No, never.

Sí, cuando se trate de una vía urbana.
Yes, if it is an urban road.

Sí, cuando se trate de una vía interurbana.
Yes, when it is an interurban road.

questions.question:

answers.text:
Sí, pero solo fuera de poblado.
Yes, but only outside built-up areas.

Sí, pero solo dentro de poblado.
Yes, but only within built-up areas.

No, si no es estrictamente necesario.
No, if not strictly necessary.

questions.help: 21 Audible warning instrument - horn The purpose of the audible warning instrument, horn, is to warn others of the presence of your vehicle.The sound emitted must be uniform and of sufficient intensity. Only certain vehicles are permitted to emit a sound of varied pitch – such as emergency service vehicles.Occasionally signs (R-310) may be displayed which forbids the sounding of the horn, except to prevent an accident.(Página 106 del manual 'Learning to drive')21 Audible warning instrument - horn The horn can only be used in certain circumstances, as a warning to:Avoid a possible accident; such as in narrow roads, hump back bridges or roads with bends with little or no visibility.To warn, on roads outside of a built-up-area, that the vehicle behind is overtaking or planning to do so.To warn other road users, that the vehicle is being used as a highpriority vehicle –normally reserved for emergency service vehicles.(Página 106 del manual 'Learning to drive')
